issue.title: sase repo open plans fails applying commit b10820e6: non-bead conflict in split_patch_handler.md
issue.description: 'sase repo open plans' fails applying commit b10820e6 ("Add SDD files for split_patch_handler") with a non-bead conflict in 202608/split_patch_handler.md, though the worktree is clean afterwards. Proposed by sase-js.9 (Adoption, glossary, and documentation) during landing of epic sase-js (Artifact reference contract). Reproduction: 'sase repo open plans' in workspace 14 hit the rebase/apply conflict on that commit; the plans worktree is clean after the failed attempt.

payload.close_reason: Backlog cut to seven (owner-requested, 2026-08-12): single unreproduced report with no standing impact. The bead's own reproduction notes that the plans worktree is clean after the failed apply of b10820e6, so 'sase repo open plans' recovers rather than leaving a broken sidecar, and no agent has reported being blocked by it since (no +1 in 6+ hours of heavy plan-sidecar traffic). Filed as a drive-by observation by sase-js.9 during epic landing, not root-caused. A one-off rebase conflict on a single historical commit does not justify a large task ahead of the currently-red gates. Reopen with a +1 if it recurs or if it ever leaves the plans worktree unusable.
